title: Inversed Pebble watchface

Hi Petr,
Can you please check in the watch face settings that the option for "Same
background colour top and bottom" is turned on? If it is, please turn it
off, save, go back into the settings and turn it on again.
If the watch face sites not have settings, then this is not the new watch
face I have been working on.
Let me know how it goes.
Cheers

If you go to the Pebble App on your phone, then to the Watch Faces tab, and
look for the xDrip Watch Face.
It should have a little "gear" symbol in the top left corner.  When you
touch this watch face icon, you will see the option Settings.
Note that if the xDrip Watch Face does not have the little gear icon, or
you do not have the Settings option when you touch it, this is not the
watch face I am working with.
I tested my version this morning after connecting my old Pebble classic.
It came up as white screen on the top as in your photo.
Once I had change the setting for Same background colour top and bottom,
and saved it, the whole screen was black background.
Cheers
